notes.title: 🔥 Battle Pass Update – Play & Earn! 🔥
notes.content:
We’re making changes to the Battle Pass progression to make it more engaging! Instead of relying on a single generator, you'll now earn Battle Pass points through active gameplay—completing event tasks and playing consistently throughout the season.

🔹 What does this mean for you?
✅ Active players will now progress naturally just by playing!
✅ Free-to-play players can complete up to 90% of the Battle Pass with regular play.
✅ No more grinding one generator—your effort across events will be rewarded!

We believe the Battle Pass should reward playing the game, not just idling in one spot. This is a big step towards making progression more fun for everyone!

🏆 Get ready to claim those rewards—this season will be worth it! 😈
